articles.summary: Fourth quarter net income of $1.45 per diluted share and adjusted operating income of $1.50 per diluted share Full year net income of $4.48 per diluted share and adjusted operating income of $4.60 per diluted share Full year return on equity of 13.7% Board of directors declares 25% increase in quarterly dividend to $0.20 per share Fourth quarter 2025 highlights compared to fourth quarter 2024: (1) Net income increased $6.9 million to $38.4 million. Net investment income increased 14% to $26.4 mi
articles.title: United Fire Group, Inc. reports fourth quarter and full year 2025 results
